verdict: HAPPY_PATH_PASS — upload→create→DB works when imageUrl is set

why: Happy path with ~2.6MB JPEG → compress → upload 201 → create 201 → DB imageUrl matches → file HTTP 200.
Upload→Create handoff of imageUrl is NOT broken when upload succeeds.
UI text «Внутренняя ошибка сервера» = errors.INTERNAL_ERROR OR user may mean DB_ERROR («Ошибка базы данных») — both are 500 on CREATE, not image process codes.
Reproduced create 500 DB_ERROR: brandId='' | brandId invalid | categoryId='' | categoryId invalid → Prisma P2003 Product_*_fkey.
warehouse/new maps brandId via `brandId || null` so empty brand is usually OK; empty/invalid category or brand FK still possible if payload bypasses UI guards.
If upload never finishes, imageUrl stays null — product can still be created WITHOUT photo (201) — looks like 'photo failed' but create succeeded.
notTheCause: ProductImageService / sharp / WebP variants for valid JPEG
imageUrl lost after successful upload (handoff proven)
Filtering PHOTO HARDEN names (those are test seed rows)
recommendedFixScopeWhenApproved: Normalize empty string FKs (brandId/categoryId/unitId) to null before Prisma
Map Prisma P2003 → typed BRAND_NOT_FOUND / CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND (not DB_ERROR/INTERNAL)
Frontend: refuse submit if category missing; show field-level errors
Do NOT treat PHOTO-MODULE upload as FAIL — add PHOTO-CREATE-E2E to certification
